thread:
alex.h: Quick check — starting a gradual rollout tomorrow for structured-output / function-calling compatibility flags in the client SDKs. Posting the plan + a couple of asks.

maria: SGTM. Can you paste the exact flag names and canary sizes so QA can prep?

alex.h: Yep — primary flags are `compat.structured_output` and `compat.fncall_behavior`. Intend to start at 5% for SDK users on `sdk_v2` and ramp to 25% over two weeks if telemetry looks good. Narrow plan: 
- Day 0: 5% (sdk_v2, internal beta orgs)
- Day 3: 10% (expand to early adopters list)
- Day 7: 25% (if no regressions)
- Rollback immediate if error rate for `fncall_compat_error` > 1% or median p99 latency regresses > 100ms

jordan: Where's the PR for the client SDK toggle? Need to land the guardrail checks before we flip.

alex.h: PR is here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4123 — includes the compatibility shim and a `compat_mode` enum. Also added telemetry events: `structured_output_mismatch`, `fncall_compat_error`, and `compat_fallback_used`.

sam: Quick note — the server-side compatibility API has two modes (`legacy` and `strict`) in that PR? If so, we should default to `legacy` for canary.

alex.h: Correct. Default server mode = `legacy` for canary so older clients still get reasonable responses. SDKs will expose `compat_mode` with opt-in for strict parsing. Example config we will push:

```
# feature flag config (service-side)
compat.structured_output = "gradual"
compat.structured_output.canary = {
  percent: 5,
  audience: "sdk_v2",
  duration_days: 7
}
compat.fncall_behavior = "legacy"
```

maria: QA checklist: 1) fuzz prompts that used previous non-structured outputs, 2) assert function call payloads still deserialize in older SDKs, 3) monitor telemetry metrics dashboard (link in ticket). I'll add items to the test plan.

nate: tagging infra: @deploy-bot can we schedule the flag rollout during low-traffic window tomorrow 03:00 UTC? Also need a quick feature-flag kill-switch runbook entry.

deploy-bot: Scheduled feature flag enable to 1785320000 (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). Kill-switch template created at https://internal.redwood/ops/feature-kill-switchs/4123.

jordan: Heads-up for code review folks — watch for these files in the PR: `compat/compat_shim.py`, `telemetry/events.py` (new events), and `sdk/config/compat_mode.rs`. Also check the canary audience selector logic — I pushed one change to audience matching to prefer `org_whitelist` before percentage.

sam: Two guardrail asks from infra: 1) Add a circuit-breaker to the SDK so it falls back to non-structured responses after X consecutive `compat_fallback_used` events (suggest X=3), 2) Expose `compat.flag_state` via the metrics endpoint.

alex.h: Agree on both. I'll update the SDK PR to include the fallback counter (client-side) and expose the flag state in the public metrics path for the canary.

maria: Also adding an eval set for quality regression testing. If structured outputs cause any schema drift, we will pause the ramp.

nate: Ops note — please add a short postmortem template to the rollout ticket so we capture lessons if we hit rollback.

alex.h: Will do. Final asks before tomorrow: 
- @maria: QA smoke at T+0 and T+6h
- @jordan: land the small audience selector fix + approve PR
- @sam: add circuit-breaker and metrics flag
- @nate: confirm scheduled window and postmortem template linked

maria: Got it. I'll be available during the window for quick checks.

jordan: I'll review and aim to merge before the window.

sam: Adding the circuit-breaker now, will ping when done.

nate: Confirmed schedule. Postmortem template linked in the ticket.

alex.h: Thanks all. If anything blocks, drop a note here and we'll delay. :thumbsup:
